title: Acute Diarrhea/Cholera Outbreak Kills One, Sickens Nearly 200 in Downtown Yangon
detail: An acute diarrhea outbreak concentrated in downtown Yangon's Lanmadaw, Latha, Pabedan and Kyauktada townships — Chinatown's crowded street-food district — sent 182 patients to Yangon General Hospital between August 9 and 13, 2026, with 93 testing positive for a diarrhea-causing pathogen (Xinhua reported cholera). A 92-year-old man died and 54 cases tested positive as of August 13; 8 patients had been discharged. Residents pointed to contaminated water — some reporting a 'rusty smell' from the Gyobyu reservoir — and takeout food amid heavy monsoon rains and flooding as likely sources; the junta opened a dedicated hospital ward for treatment.

media.caption: An acute diarrhea outbreak tied to flooding and contaminated water sickens nearly 200 in downtown Yangon.

title: Junta Jet Bombs Kyeintali Town, Killing 8 Civilians Including Two Children
detail: Around 11:30pm on August 13, 2026, a junta fighter jet dropped two bombs into a residential neighborhood on Maytta Paung Ku Street, Ward 1, Kyeintali Town, Gwa Township, Rakhine State — an area under Arakan Army control since December 2024 with no ground combat underway. Eight civilians were killed instantly inside their homes: Daw Khin Moe Shwe (60), Daw Khin Sandar Tun (45), U Tun Lin (46), Ma Phyo Phyo Kyaw (36), Maung Min Wai Khant (35), Ma Win Ei Kyaw (26), and two children, Maung Nyan Lin Thant (12) and Maung Nay Lin Thant (7). Five houses and a motor tricycle were destroyed. A separate junta jet bombed nearby Kaing Khon village the same night (10:55pm) with no reported casualties.

media.caption: Junta jet bombs a residential neighborhood in Kyeintali Town, killing eight civilians including two children.
